name: Seurat's Hoard
purpose: Voxel studio: draw voxel models in a 3D editor and turn pictures (artwork, sprites, pixel art) or a description into voxel models, instantly (inflate, extrude, front + side silhouettes) or with the language model (DeepSeek on the Sparks by default), which reasons at length and writes a program that builds the voxels, run in a sandbox and improved round after round from renders of its result. Exports MagicaVoxel .vox, GLB, STL for printing and PNG renders / isometric sprites. Assistants can create, edit, look at and export models.
notes: Axes: x right, y up, z towards the viewer; c is a palette index (0 erases). reference_add then generate_start (poll generate_status; with effort max a round takes several minutes) for a model-made voxel version (method agent, default: the model runs, looks at and fixes its Python voxel program in a loop until done; code: fixed rounds; ops: JSON operations), or generate_start with only a prompt and a size for an object or scene from a description; build_from_image for an instant one. model_ops edits with operations (line with r is a capsule, prism is a polygon with thickness for wings and fins). model_look returns a picture (also overworld_front/back/left/right: the game camera looking down); model_sprite_match compares a model with game sprites from their camera (silhouette match per view and a diff picture), and generate_start with target sprite rebuilds overworld sprites in 3D judged that way after every run (the side sprite is a true profile and counts double); model_program with sprites gives a program SIDE, carve_side, paint_side and paint_view; model_export writes .vox, .glb, .stl (millimetres) or PNG/sprites and returns the path. Every change keeps the previous content as a version. reference_frames reads every frame of a GIF or every cell of a sprite sheet and guesses which show front, back and sides; a reference with role sheet (or a role and frames) gives generate_start and model_sprite_match one camera view per side, the other frames as poses. model_sprite_calibrate finds each sprite's camera angle from a model's silhouette (apply saves the heights); generations calibrate by themselves. model_look views lit, lit_front_left, lit_back_left, lit_back_right, lit_front, lit_top and sheet_lit have cast shadows and ambient occlusion (any yaw/pitch); model_spin writes a turntable GIF or WebM. generate_start with method scene plans a big scene (up to 256 a side) as objects built by their own programs and placed on the ground. generate_round returns any round of a generation and save=true makes it a model.
